responsibility: This definition module exposes the top-level compilation driver for mc. It provides the entry point that translates one source file through the compiler’s staged parsing pipeline and a getter for the current pass number, letting other modules coordinate pass-sensitive behavior without embedding the pass scheduler themselves.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the narrow public interface for the mcComp stem, exporting only compile and getPassNo; the same-named .mod file contains the actual pass scheduler, source opening, module-kind probing, and multi-pass orchestration logic.
